verdict.rationale: Plaid's first-party docs describe Balance as a dedicated product for real-time balance information. They say it is commonly used to check sufficient funds before an account funds a payment, which is exactly the NSF/risk pre-payment check this story asks for. Missing for 10: the specific balance endpoint and its request/response details are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch a real-time balance for a connected account before initiating a payment — a documented balance endpoint intended for NSF and risk checks

citations.quote: Balance is Plaid's product for receiving real-time balance information. This data is commonly used to tell if an account has sufficient funds before using it as a funding source for a payment transaction
